text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain and later buying it back at a higher price reminds me that a realized gain is not a reason to exit; I should base trades on my portfolio plan, not the pleasure of locking in profit.","My later purchases show how easily I can re-enter after selling winners; before trading, I should check whether the decision improves my overall allocation rather than reacting to a stock’s price or my past cost.","The account’s month-to-month gains and losses are mixed, and past moves do not predict future ones; I should stay patient, keep risk diversified, and trade only when my goals or portfolio needs warrant it."]}
